title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job description:**

We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

The candidate will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms
* Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories
* Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking
* Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics
* Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials
* Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field
* 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments
* Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics
* Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello
* Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle
* Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms
* Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences
* Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus
* Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

**Deployment Location: Goa**  
**Work Mode: Onsite (Mon-Sat)**

Job Type: Contractual- 1 year (Can extend up to 6 months based on project requirements)

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About the role**



We are looking for a Product Manager to own treasury for our HCM (Human Capital Management) platform, the systems that move money reliably across currencies, banking partners, and borders so our global clients can trust that payroll lands correctly, every time. You will own execution across the full product lifecycle for treasury and funds flow, from discovery through delivery, working cross\-functionally with engineering, finance/treasury operations, compliance, and go\-to\-market.



This is a role for someone who has done this before – You have owned a roadmap involving money movement, banking rails, or payments infrastructure, and you know how to turn ambiguity, and the real constraints of financial regulation, into a clear plan without.



You will report directly to our Head of Product.


### **What You'll Do**


**Product development**


* Drive discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and roadmap development across the treasury and funds\-flow lifecycle, funding models, banking partnerships, payment rails, and FX
* Own the product experience for billing, invoicing, credit memos, and payment application, working closely with finance and business operations
* Translate strategy into clear, actionable requirements and user stories engineering can build from
* Own product documentation (business cases, use cases, technical requirements, and expected ROI) with particular attention to compliance and risk implications
* Make sure every release lines up with both customer needs and company goals, without compromising financial controls


**Stakeholder engagement**


* Turn feedback from internal stakeholders (finance, treasury ops, compliance) and external customers into concrete prioritization decisions
* Act as the connective tissue between engineering and the rest of the business, keeping treasury features aligned with market needs and regulatory requirements
* Partner with engineering, QA, design, compliance, and banking partners to plan, build, and launch
* Run Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) and keep them useful, not performative
* Work with QA to define testing strategy and protect release quality, especially around fund movement and reconciliation


**Market awareness \& research**


* Stay sharp on treasury, banking, and payments trends, regulatory shifts, customer pain points, and the competitive landscape
* Use that knowledge to keep the roadmap a step ahead, not just reactive


**Documentation \& reporting**


* Keep clear, current documentation for project plans, timelines, requirements, and status
* Communicate progress and learnings to stakeholders on a regular cadence
* Develop external\-facing content on treasury\-related features and functionality for customers

### **What You'll Bring**


* 3\-5 years of experience in product management or a closely related role at a technology or SaaS company
* A track record of owning the product lifecycle and shipping impactful B2B solutions, ideally involving payments, treasury, or money movement
* Strong collaboration and communication skills. You will work fluidly across engineering, design, finance, and compliance teams
* Comfort turning complex business and regulatory needs into clear technical requirements
* Real experience in Agile environments, including hands\-on sprint planning and backlog grooming
* A customer\-first mindset balanced with strategic thinking and tactical execution
* A self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and fast pace
* Experience in treasury, payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure is strongly preferred; HCM or enterprise software experience is a plus
* Familiarity with billing, invoicing, AR, and pricing models (tiered pricing especially) in a B2B context
* Exposure to ERP systems — ERPNext experience is a plus

description:

**About StarClinch**  
StarClinch is India's leading artist booking platform, connecting brands, corporates, event organizers, and individuals with top artists, influencers, celebrities, speakers, and entertainers. We're transforming the entertainment industry through technology, innovation, and exceptional customer experiences.

**What you'll own**

**Demand (B2B \+ B2C bookings)**

* Own the full acquisition funnel across paid, organic/SEO, content, and lifecycle for corporate buyers and B2C event clients (weddings, private events).
* Improve lead\-to\-booking conversion — landing pages, enquiry flow, response times, remarketing, and CRO across the booking journey.
* Build repeat and referral loops with corporate accounts and event planners; convert one\-off bookers into repeat demand.

**Supply (artist network — marketplace supply, not employees)**

* Grow and *activate* the artist base: acquisition of new artists in priority categories/cities, plus lifting the share of listed artists who actually get booked.
* Improve listing quality, availability, and responsiveness so supply is bookable, not just registered.
* Balance supply against demand by category and geography — surface and fix liquidity gaps (e.g., high demand / thin supply for a genre or city, or vice versa).

**Cross\-funnel \& analytics**

* Own the growth dashboard: define, instrument, and report the metrics below; run a weekly experiment cadence with clear hypotheses and readouts.
* Prioritise the roadmap by impact\-to\-effort under a lean budget — no vanity spend; every rupee tied to a funnel metric.
* Partner with product/ops/engineering to remove friction in the match between demand and supply.

**Team \& partnerships**

* Directly manage 1–2 growth team members — set priorities, coach, and review work.
* Build partnership/BD channels where they beat paid (venues, wedding planners, corporate HR/admin, event agencies) and stand up outbound where it's the cheaper path to qualified demand.

**What you'll be measured on**

* **GMV and completed bookings** (volume and value)
* **Net revenue / take\-rate contribution**
* **CAC and CAC payback**, by channel and by side of the marketplace
* **Artist activation rate** — % of listed artists receiving bookings in a period
* **Liquidity / match rate** — enquiries converted to confirmed bookings; supply–demand balance by category and city
* **Lead\-to\-booking conversion** and **repeat booking rate**

**Who you are (must\-haves)**

* 3\+ years in growth, ideally at a marketplace, consumer\-internet, or two\-sided platform — you understand liquidity, not just top\-of\-funnel spend.
* Hands\-on generalist: you've personally run paid \+ organic/SEO \+ at least one of partnerships or sales\-led motions, and can still get into the account/dashboard yourself.
* Strong analytical operator — you pull and interpret your own data (GA4 \+ spreadsheets minimum; SQL or no\-code analytics a plus) and make budget calls from it.
* Have managed or closely mentored 1–2 people, or can clearly demonstrate readiness to.
* Comfortable in ambiguity and resource constraints — you'd rather ship a scrappy test this week than a perfect plan next quarter.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to events, entertainment, weddings, or a services marketplace.
* Comfort with no\-code/low\-code growth and automation tooling.
* Both B2B and B2C growth experience.

**Benefits**

* 27 days of paid leave a year \- generous time off to rest and recharge, well above the statutory minimum.
* Health and accidental insurance coverage \- so you and your peace of mind are protected from day one.
* Startup exposure — a young, dynamic team and the kind of fast, ownership\-driven environment where you see your work land.
* Real influence \- a high\-impact role shaping team building and company culture from the front.

Pay: From ₹50,000\.00 per month

About the Role

NourishGlobal Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and driven **Manager – Exports** to lead and establish our international export business for **fresh and frozen aqua products** across European and Asian markets. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in exporting **livestock, seafood/aqua, agricultural, or related perishable products from India**, along with a solid understanding of international logistics, documentation, compliance, market development, and customer management.

This is a key leadership role for someone who can **build an export team, develop international markets, identify buyers, establish distribution channels, manage the complete export cycle, and drive sustainable international business growth.**

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute the company's export strategy for fresh and frozen aqua products in European and Asian markets.
* Identify and develop new international customers, importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and institutional buyers.
* Build and manage a dedicated **Export/International Business team** from the ground up.
* Develop strong relationships with overseas buyers and maintain long\-term business partnerships.
* Handle the complete export process, from enquiry and quotation to order processing, shipment, documentation, and payment realization.
* Coordinate with sourcing, production, quality, packaging, logistics, freight forwarders, CHA/customs agents, and other stakeholders.
* Manage international logistics, including **cold\-chain transportation, freight forwarding, shipping schedules, container planning, and shipment coordination**.
* Ensure compliance with export documentation, customs procedures, country\-specific import requirements, and applicable food/aqua product regulations.
* Research international markets, competitors, pricing, demand trends, and potential business opportunities.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment terms, freight, and contracts with international customers.
* Develop and maintain a strong international buyer database and sales pipeline.
* Monitor export orders, shipment timelines, receivables, margins, and overall business performance.
* Work closely with management to establish export targets, budgets, and growth plans.
* Travel internationally/domestically when required for buyer meetings, trade fairs, supplier visits, and business development.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer, logistics, quality, and shipment\-related issues.
* Prepare regular reports on export sales, market development, customer acquisition, shipments, and business performance.

Candidate Profile

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further


International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.


We are currently seeking an experienced person to join the WPB Premier Services Team

**Role Purpose**

* The HSBC Premier offering is one of the world’s first globally linked banking offerings. And of strategic importance for HSBC, the role requires you to be part of premier relationship team across branches
* The role provides dedicated support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRM) in the overall achievement of their income plans (covering acquisition, cross sales, retention, and growth of their portfolios) and day to day contact with their clients in the delivery of the proposition objectives
* In order to deliver client centric service the role also requires you to be a point of contact for clients as and when required and provide customer with a memorable service experience by having a problem solving attitude


In addition, the Premier Officer may provide credit/lending support to the PRM if dictated by market requirements. Building an ongoing relationship based on value and service is critical to being successful in this role.


In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to demonstrate an extensive knowledge of banking products and services across wealth and retail.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Impact on the business**

* Provide high quality sales support to a team of PRMs mainly focused on getting appointment for PRMs and supporting PRMs in servicing their clients
* Reduce the time spent on process and administrative tasks by PRM to increase PRM’s capacity
* Support PRMs to manage client contact and service, including, in the absence of PRMs, answering client calls, resolving client enquiries on transactional needs and facilitating a smooth hand\-off to the correct channels where appropriate, and managing key event reminders to maintain active client contact
* Provide sales support to PRMs including preparing and completing sales documents, managing data input and report generation, and liaising with support functions to follow through client purchase process requirement

**Clients/Stakeholders**

* Handle client’s enquiries relating to the PRM’s portfolio in a positive, timely, and appropriate manner. Aim to resolve the customer’s queries at the first point of contact and minimise referrals to the PRM for routine transactions.
* Has strong knowledge of the PRM’s portfolio of clients with the support of CRMS and analytical tools
* Proactively responds to client in face\-to\-face and/or telephone settings, updating client profile screens with details of client contact
* Maintains a basic understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services
* Support PRMs to execute suitable solutions for product areas responsible for with clients to fulfill their needs and ensure efficient follow up
* Manager the Premier desk (including required contact activity) in the absence of PRM.
* Assist the PRM in organizing events as and when required.
* Refer the attrition cases to PRM immediately
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to manage Premier TAT / customer expectations

**Leadership and teamwork**

* Communicate effectively and works well with other teams within the Branch, Call Center, HTS, and other relevant partners that impact the client’s experience of HSBC; in order to ensure a consistent approach and application of Premier standards
* Efficiently manages time in order to support different PRMs concurrently
* Proactively identifies opportunities/issues and provides feedback to branch management and HTS to improve products and service processes
* Delivering the firm \- Put the client at the heart of our business and deliver joined up services and solutions aligned to customer needs.

**Operational effectiveness and control**

* Ensure all processes and procedures are accurate and in accordance with HSBC Bank policy standards, regulatory requirements, Group Compliance Policy and Internal Controls.
* Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling
* Zero discrepancies on documentation for new Liability \& Wealth accounts.
* Ensure 100% accuracy on all KYC and Non KYC documentation and processing of customer instructions
* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD \& EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**

* Provide high quality support to PRMs
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures in order to handle client needs
* Proactively help HSBC identify opportunity to improve process efficiencies
* Sensitively redirect clients to the most effective and efficient channel
* Support the client in navigating the channel of their choice (to interact with HSBC) effectively and efficiently
* Ensure the client consistently receives a professional premium service which exceeds their expectations at all times
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations
* Ensuring the highest standards of customer service in terms of timeliness and customer experience.
* Enhancing customer confidence in the bank’s Global Premier proposition by ensuring the offer of a relevant product suite and supporting this through systematic and regular communication is a key aspect of the role.
* given the growth aspirations of the WM business, the jobholder is to constantly source, develop and grow Premier relationships in a highly competitive market. The said role requires to balance customer servicing activity along with sales acquisition while ensuring the necessary growth in the existing portfolio coupled with minimal attrition.
* Another key challenge is to be able to provide superior service to all walk in customers as per guidelines

**Role Context**


Premier is a key proposition in the bank’s strategy. Over recent years, our business and organisation has made considerable progress both in our performance versus peer group and in our strategic transformation. Over the medium term we have been improving both our profitability and our ability to meet the needs of our target clients.


We have four overriding principles that will apply to the delivery of all propositions, products and services through all channels to all customers at all times:

* We will treat all customers fairly
* We will apply the HSBC Group values and business principles in all of our dealings with customers
* We will meet, or exceed, all local and international laws, regulations, and codes of practice
* We will deliver services to customers in a manner that provides speed, ease, certainty and empathy

**Management of Risk**


Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**


Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Has exceptional and updated knowledge of Banking products, systems and processes.
* Is well organized and depicts professional image
* Displays extra\-ordinary Business focus and customer orientation and provides exemplary service
* Is self\-motivated and has the drive to overachieve on goals and targets set out
* Displays close bonding with immediate team members and skillful association with support group colleagues

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree / Graduation with 2 years of experience
* Holistic understanding of the Branch Operations and Processes of the bank
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements
* **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage

**Additional Information**

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.


You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives** across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* **Translate complex technical and business requirements** into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* **Track and improve AI system performance** through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices**, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

▸ Manage monthly ad budget starting ₹50,000–1,00,000 with clear ROAS targets

▸ Run special campaigns around Amazon/Flipkart sale events to capture deal\-seeking traffic on callas.in

**3\. Instagram (@official.callas)**

▸ Post 3–4 reels per week: assembly time\-lapses, before/after room transformations, unboxing → assembled shots, customer testimonials

▸ Grow from current \~1,400 followers to 10,000\+ in 6 months through consistent content \+ paid promotion

▸ Set up Instagram Shopping (linked to Shopify via Meta Commerce Manager) so products are tappable in posts/reels

▸ Respond to DMs, comments, and inquiries promptly — this is a sales channel, not just branding

▸ Coordinate with factory team for raw content — you'll visit Bahalgarh periodically to shoot assembly/production footage

**4\. Google Shopping \+ SEO**

▸ Set up and manage Google Merchant Center via Shopify's Google channel app (catalog auto\-sync)

▸ Run Google Shopping ads on high\-intent keywords like 'study table under 5000', 'shoe rack with seating', 'DIY bed'

▸ Basic on\-page SEO — product titles, descriptions, blog posts targeting furniture buying queries

**5\. Other Channels**

▸ List top SKUs on Meesho for tier 2/3 city reach

▸ Manage a Callas YouTube channel — upload assembly videos, room setup ideas, product comparisons

▸ Create and maintain a 'Bulk Orders' page on callas.in for B2B/corporate inquiries (co\-living spaces, hostels, offices)

▸ Pinterest — pin room setup photos with product links

**Using Claude (AI) as a Core Work Tool**

This is non\-negotiable. We use Claude (by Anthropic) as a daily productivity tool across the business. You will be trained on it and expected to use it for:

**Ad copy \& content** — Listing optimization

▸ Upload Amazon/Flipkart keyword data → Claude analyzes gaps, rewrites titles, bullets, descriptions with the right keywords baked in

**PPC optimization** — Ad performance analysis

▸ Download weekly Search Term Reports, Campaign Reports → upload to Claude or the Callas Ops Console (internal tool) → get exact actions: which keywords to scale, which to negative\-match, which bids to change

**Content creation** — Creative briefing

▸ Use Claude to draft Instagram captions, ad copy variations, email sequences, blog posts, product descriptions — then edit for brand voice

**Market intelligence** — Competitor analysis

▸ Paste competitor listings, reviews, or Brand Analytics exports into Claude → get positioning insights, keyword gaps, content improvements

**Weekly summaries** — Reporting

▸ Use Claude to turn raw data (Shopify analytics, Meta ads dashboard, Google Analytics) into concise weekly reports with action items for the founder

You don't need prior experience with Claude specifically — we'll train you. But you must be comfortable working with AI tools, prompting them effectively, and integrating them into daily workflows rather than doing everything manually.

**RequirementsMust Have**

▸ 1–3 years of hands\-on experience running a Shopify or similar e\-commerce store

▸ Proven experience running Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns with measurable ROAS results — show us your numbers

▸ Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, Pixel setup, and audience building

▸ Basic design skills — Canva at minimum; Figma or Photoshop is a plus. You'll make creatives, not just brief them
